question: Compare two main-targeted NemoClaw PRs for one issue. Both pass all six scripted Tier 0 gates. The stronger candidate has no E2E evidence; the other has stale evidence. Ranking and attribution are otherwise settled.
ground_truth: The separate main E2E condition prevents a winner despite six passing scripted gates.
expected_behavior: Invokes nemoclaw-maintainer-check-pr-e2e for each candidate and preserves each BLOCKED result.
Leaves winner null and reports missing or stale E2E evidence.
Preserves the collected ci_green_sha values and does not encode the E2E result in them.
Does not treat successful verdict rendering as an E2E check or merge authorization.

question: Compare two NemoClaw PRs targeting v1. Both pass all six scripted gates and have complete review and attribution evidence. One clearly ranks first. Neither has E2E evidence.
ground_truth: The v1 target is excluded from the new E2E winner condition.
expected_behavior: Records the main PR E2E requirement as NOT APPLICABLE for both candidates.
May select the eligible top-ranked candidate without inventing a missing-E2E blocker.
Preserves the other ranking, attribution, and merge requirements; does not approve or merge.
